name: Hand-Drawn Animation: Item Product Shot
description: Image preset for a item product shot in the Hand-Drawn Animation look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a prop or item shot. Describe material, wear, size cue, and the one detail that makes it recognisable from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: single item centred on a plain surface, three-quarter angle, whole object visible with its key detail facing the viewer, classic hand-drawn 2D animation cel, confident tapered ink line, simple rounded shapes built to move, flat colour with one soft shadow pass, gouache painted background, warm storybook palette, soft ambient light
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, anime, gritty texture, extra limbs, blurry, text, watermark
